phrase: A chip maker's chief resigned over an affair with an alleged foreign intelligence contact, erasing a trillion dollars. The same day, a search giant launched a smarter chatbot model.
phraseAlternatives: A chip maker's boss quit amid an affair scandal as markets erased a trillion dollars, while lawmakers opened a fresh investigation into the company's dealings with China.
While a chip maker's scandal wiped out a trillion dollars in value, families asked schools to pause a chatbot linked to a teenager's death.
A chip maker's longtime chief stepped down after an affair with an alleged intelligence contact, as the company lost over a trillion dollars overnight.
alt: A leaning company building with a flat roof and an open door stands on the left, its sign toppled at the base and a small chart with a falling line resting near its feet. A worried person walks away carrying a suitcase. A thin dashed line divides the scene. On the right, a calm robot stands beside a conveyor belt, rolling a shiny new gear off the end.

brief.concept: A chip maker's chief executive walks out the door as the company's stock craters, while across town a calm AI robot rolls a brand-new model off the assembly line like nothing happened.
brief.metaphor: A toppled company sign beside an assembly line that keeps running without a pause.
